test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Name a common ingredient made from the starchy part of corn kernels used as a thickening agent for gravies, marinades, sauces, soups and casseroles.
solution:
The correct answer is** Corn starch.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **The starch** is obtained from the** endosperm of the kernel.**
 
• These** endosperms** are ground into a fine, **white powder.**
 
• Corn starch&
